text:
Maya: Quick sync  we need a lean GA readiness checklist for tomorrow's rollout. One-liners only: SLA line, runbook link + owner, oncall thresholds, monitoring alerts, pricing smoke. Need closes by EOD.

Ben: I'll take monitoring + oncall. Quick checks:
- 10m smoke at 09:00 UTC (8-12 qps)
- p95 < 350ms for small payloads
- alert if 5xx > 5% over 5m -> page SRE
- include runbook url in alert payload

Ivy: I'll own docs/runbook and SLA blurb. I'll add a 1-page TL;DR, curl snippets, and the exact error strings.

Maya: Owners: Ben -> monitoring/oncall, Ivy -> docs/SLA. I'll own the pricing smoke (will run quick tokenized load and check billing tags). Please ack when started.

DeployBot: Ticket created: PROJ-777 "GA readiness lean checklist" assigned to Maya, Ben, Ivy. Due EOD.

Ben: Ack. Running burnin at 09:00 UTC and will paste summary here.

Ivy: Ack. Drafted runbook at internal://docs/runbooks/ga-lean.md (placeholder) and SLA sentence: "We target 99.5% uptime for the hosted inference API, excluding scheduled maintenance and force majeure."

Maya: Pricing smoke plan: 10m job, qps=10, payload=128; will verify billing includes X-Cost-Tag=ga-lean and per-token meter.

(09:12) Ben: Burnin complete. p95=310ms, one 20s spike at 09:05 that triggered alert and auto-fallback. Alert included runbook link. Logged snapshot to PROJ-777.

(09:25) Maya: Pricing smoke complete. Billing tag present and token counts match load. No unexpected cost delta. CSV attached to PROJ-777.

Ivy: Updated runbook with curl snippets, error strings "model_kv_overflow" and "quota_exceeded_token_limit", and a 3-step rollback. Link updated.

Maya: Great. Final step: drop a :white_check_mark: when your area is done and I'll send the handoff to sales/support.

Ben: :white_check_mark:

Ivy: :white_check_mark:

Maya: :white_check_mark:
